name: Lightless Star
body:
School evocation [darkness]; Level death mage 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a shifting orb of shadow that explodes in the target area. The spell deals 1d6 points of damage per caster level (maximum 15d6). Half of the damage is cold, and the other half is negative energy. This negative energy does not harm undead, nor does it heal them.
